name: acid-slide-2
about: Re-check: slides that really glide (notes that run past the next).

name: scrap-it
about: Re-check: starting over with a new project.

steps.say: make a dubstep beat with a wobble bass
scrap all of it, I want a fresh empty project

name: sixth-below
about: Re-check: a harmony read against its melody.

steps.say: write a 2 bar melody on track 5 in D major
add a harmony a sixth below it on track 6, same rhythm

name: slow-swell
about: Re-check: envelope times in seconds for a swell.

steps.say: put a pad chord on track 8 for 4 bars
make it swell in slowly over about 2 seconds

name: swing-already-zero
about: Re-check: a walkthrough to a value already set, on another page.

steps.say: light the keys to show me where to set the swing to 0

name: lab-hat-takes
about: Re-check: lab takes with drum grids by name, read back.

steps.say: make a boom bap beat
give me three different hi-hat patterns to choose from

name: how-arp-works
about: Re-check: how a feature works, one idea and a demonstration.

steps.say: how does the arpeggiator work?

name: remove-roll
about: Re-check: a step component taken off.

steps.say: make a trap beat with hi-hat rolls
remove the last hi-hat roll, keep the others

name: f-sharp-major
about: Re-check: a key named with sharps reads in sharps.

steps.say: write a chord progression in F# major on track 7 and tell me the chords

name: open-hat-end
about: An open hat placed on the last sixteenth of each bar.

steps.say: make a 2 bar house beat
open the hi-hat on the last sixteenth of every bar

name: build-a-song
about: A song built up over several turns, then arranged.

steps.say: make a beat at 100 bpm
add a bassline
add some chords
now turn it into a song with an intro and an outro

about: A fact about the device's limits.

steps.say: how many notes can the op-xy play at once?

name: mono-vs-legato
about: A concept question that wants a demonstration.

steps.say: what's the difference between mono and legato on the op-xy?

name: question-answer
about: A melody with a musical form: question and answer.

steps.say: write a melody on track 5 that sounds like a question and then an answer
make a techno beat
it's boring, make something different happen every 4th bar

name: external-channel-3
about: An external synth on a MIDI channel.

steps.say: set track 4 up to play my external synth on midi channel 3, and give it a bassline
make a beat that swings like J Dilla, drunk and loose

name: filter-sweep-4
about: A filter that opens over four bars.

steps.say: put a 4 bar chord loop on track 7
make the filter open slowly over the 4 bars, then snap shut at the loop
